unsupported_claims: The most likely candidate is Bahmani, Chowdhury and Goel's work on fast incremental PageRank using stored random walks; the evidence concerns DeepWalk, not this paper.

That work reported update speedups over full recomputation of roughly one to two orders of magnitude on large real-world graphs such as Twitter-scale social networks; the evidence reports no measured speedup.
rationale: The evidence only claims that updates can be done in sub-linear time and gives no measured speedup or benchmark.
